create_parameter_with_init: create a Haiku parameter using base.get_parameter with a name, shape, and init function inside a new_context
create_state_with_custom_creator: create Haiku state using base.get_state wrapped in a custom_creator context manager to intercept initialization
manage_rng_keys: manage random number generation in Haiku using base.next_rng_key and base.next_rng_keys inside a transform
use_prng_sequence: use base.PRNGSequence to generate a sequence of split JAX PRNG keys with reserve and take methods
customize_getter_and_setter: customize Haiku state values using base.custom_getter and base.custom_setter context managers to transform values on access and assignment
